2026-10-24 工作日志

当日回看

  • 卸载保存对象由checkpoint边界决定：UniRL激活卸载原回调接真实CPU autograd八组：仅offload会保存参数/输入/中间值，叠checkpoint本例仅输入；dtype保持、stride可变，参数身份/state key不变。非设备传输/显存或FSDP/EP验收，不能把元素计数变成容量收益；真机条件补M5原参考，不自动启flag或排训练。

  • step标签不是训练步存储协议：verl gauge后续核新#8357与#8315重叠；原logger→固定SDK emit/push四分支控制，前者保留原名/字符串step标签，后者metric_log输出整数global_step trace。捕获sink不认证服务/存储；若标签直接作维度则每步新组合，不另写修复、部署监控或排GPU任务。

  • 计算分片不等于驻留分片或通用恢复：视频VAE状态协商核#469仍draft且依赖fork的H3 SP；三项静态AST保持内层算法，公开hook/slicing未复制，汇总后全rank仍持有视频。非解码/collective/性能验收；真机条件补原M5参考，不新增必跑任务或开发并行SP方案。

  • 零步控制不是充分认证：UniRL离线DPO原归约与后半数学片段CPU检查：正确配对/跨prompt重排均可log2且accuracy0，策略梯度仍非零；偶数布局、语义配对与参考身份分开。非完整算法、模型或CUDA确定性验收，不另起修复/新M5任务。

  • 参考图数不是样本数：UniRL多参考容器原CPU容器3行5图保持owner/像素形状/metadata，重复选整行保留别名，稠密槽拒绝混合图数；legacy两图默认归两行而非一行双参考。非Part/fork或模型/训练验收，已有作者不另起修复/硬件队列；#562仅核新merge及AR blob相同，不重跑旧验证。

  • 加严共享校验也可能破坏合法模式：UniRL prompt契约核#497仍open但维护者已反对按现状合入；合法无文本音视频请求在三版选择方法对照中仅被候选拒绝，ImageBind默认模式与调用顺序为源码证据，非模型回归。缺失/空串/长度不齐分开，不另演化修复或新增M5任务。

  • 比较计时前先补齐同一工作：UniRL原生配置报告复算公开五行，完整训练+0.782%，错配actor-only会变成+33.672%；prompt选取哈希匹配，但不是实际资产或运行验收。不同物理节点/精度/执行路径不作质量或统计等价，未跑性能/设备或新增M5任务。

  • 内部版本常量与消息身份分开：UniRL Pipe学习八组原runtime真实spawn/Pipe控制，严格连续整数ID/非空command仍保留；合法信封不等于可执行命令，其他HTTP/IPC版本未删除。#568明确未修#567，H20阻塞不解除；非完整引擎/设备验收，无新M5任务。

  • 引用布局不等于张量接口：UniRL逐行索引后续复现#589两步修复的不同作用，三版×三布局控制；最终只读三个索引、保留latent handles，原Segment拼接不读payload，显式hydrate后数值一致。CPU handle/前沿为夹具，非Ray/远端或模型验收；#563核心统计AST迁移保持，不重复旧数值实验，无新M5任务。

  • 反向资格不等于统计资格：UniRL空响应后续核#598合并main后的新guard；两版六输入原方法控制，父提交全空/混合抛KeyError、新head六项通过。全空偏差0是无有效观测，不是anchor一致性实测；非算法/训练/通信验收，旧GPU证据不迁移，无新M5任务或重复修复。

  • Parity需绑定联合版本与配置：UniRL分拆尽调确认#430拆#504/#505、同作者已有实现；原/分拆vLLM与缓存开关不混用，selected-token精确前向不等于梯度/optimizer或任意栈保证。无本机parity/设备执行，不重复实现或新排M5任务。

  • Judge零分不能反推明确判错或失败已过滤：回复协议原方法七组本地Response控制通过，观察关键词否定/长回复边界、未识别不重试、空choices/503重试归零；success=True仅源码接线。非真实judge/超时/奖励栈或训练验收，不擅改协议、发上游或新增M5任务。

  • 旧TP1报告、已合并HTTP同步和未合并通用placement分开：UniRL TP后续核#222因后续取代关闭、#226已合并限定范围、#318关闭未合并；不把旧限制当当前事实，也不把作者历史H20实测搬成本机/当前head验收。无重复TP补丁或新增M5任务。

  • 标题不是需求，方向认可不是验收或本机授权：UniRL需求边界核#433正文null、#416维护者已邀原提议者做可选judge文档/配置；不自行改CI或抢写provider，也不发送prompt/API key或调用付费endpoint。无代码/设备执行，不新增M5任务。

  • key覆盖、可读性和编码器身份分开：UniRL离线embedding原store真实CPU文件控制两次一致：3 prompt/2片读回，缺片coverage过/get拒绝；resume核字符串而非权重内容，单次rename失败后旧index保持、新resume可恢复。非模型编码、共享存储/断电或训练验收，不新增M5任务。

  • RFC未关不等于功能未合入：UniRL分项覆盖确认#450的#513、#537的#548/#549/#550均merged；只覆盖H3缓存及限定BAGEL路径，非整个RFC/所有算法或本机验收。不重复实现，也不将剩余路线自动认领；无新M5任务。

  • 续跑下限也按整条响应累计：verl续跑长度核#8356；原四测试协程隔离执行，base三断言失败、head四通过，下限不重置、不补缺失值。非完整pytest/追踪/Ray/真实后端或EOS验收，不新增M5任务。

  • 配置默认和更新次数各有现成推进者：verl资源与调度尽调确认#7398已有同报告者#8340、旧#7525关闭未合并；#8099已有下游实现/原型，固定次数、UID分组和分母契约不可混为完整覆盖。未执行Ray/TQ/训练或复跑作者测试，不另起竞争补丁/新硬件任务。

  • 测试隔离不等于容量或设备保证：verl缓存与临时目录核#8343的输出路径、pytest根和配置锁声明；两项原路径赋值/真实pytest CPU控制通过，非原引擎、HF保存、真实只读挂载或配额故障复现。锁消费者不在verl Python中，不能以YAML声明充当适配层验收；不新增M5任务。

  • 防御 guard 不是已证根因，旧关闭评论不是当前状态：verl部分覆盖尽调核#8122/#8125仍未消除原崩溃、#8000当前重开且#8003/#8056分SFT/RL叠加推进；不重复实现或把相关性当因果。无候选代码执行/原测试/设备验收，作者回移GPU结果不搬当前head，不新增M5任务。

  • 失败传播、内容一致和读取终止不是同一保证：UniRL教师边界核#515后续澄清/#575已合并与当前调用链；取消仅尽力、hash在读完后，均不保证卡住读取结束。原指纹函数6组CPU控制、5模块compile，非Ray/Gloo/教师或训练验收；不重复已有修复/新增M5任务。

  • mask 总数正确不等于 response 边界正确：异步奖励补齐原构造/消费片段三组两版本 CPU 对照两次一致；旧末条2误读5、6误读1，head恢复长度但拼接更宽，第二组应有惩罚反而增加。非完整worker/TQ/位置ID/多模态或原pytest验收，无新GPU任务；已有作者不竞争。

import ast, hashlib, json, os, subprocess
import torch
from typing import Dict
repo='/Users/jackiemac/Documents/Codex/2026-10-20/new-chat/work/unirl-readonly'
rev='6fd82cba13f52f394747832344039408699ea378'
paths=['unirl/train/lora.py','unirl/distributed/group/ray_utils.py','unirl/distributed/group/handle.py','unirl/trainer/hydra.py','unirl/train/backend/base_backend.py']
sources={p:subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',repo,'show',f'{rev}:{p}'],env=dict(os.environ,GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH='1')) for p in paths}
for p,raw in sources.items(): compile(raw, p, 'exec')
tree=ast.parse(sources[paths[0]])
fn=next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='_weights_sha256')
ns={'hashlib':hashlib,'torch':torch,'Dict':Dict}
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[fn],type_ignores=[]),'original_weights_sha256','exec'),ns)
f=ns['_weights_sha256']
a=torch.arange(6,dtype=torch.float32).reshape(2,3)
original={'a':a,'b':torch.tensor([2.],dtype=torch.float32)}
x=f(original)
assert x==f({'b':original['b'],'a':a.clone()})
noncontiguous=a.t().contiguous().t()
assert not noncontiguous.is_contiguous() and x==f({'a':noncontiguous,'b':original['b']})
changed={k:v.clone() for k,v in original.items()}; changed['a'][0,0]=1
assert x!=f(changed)
assert x!=f({'a':a.double(),'b':original['b']})
assert x!=f({'a':a.reshape(3,2),'b':original['b']})
assert x!=f({'renamed':a,'b':original['b']})

import ast
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile
from types import ModuleType
from unittest.mock import patch

import torch
import safetensors

REPO = Path(__file__).parent / "unirl-readonly"
for name in ("unirl", "unirl.config", "unirl.utils", "unirl.models",
             "unirl.models.minimax_h3", "unirl.models.minimax_h3.vendor"):
    module = ModuleType(name)
    module.__path__ = []
    sys.modules[name] = module
tree = ast.parse((REPO / "unirl/models/minimax_h3/vendor/packing.py").read_text())
node = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign)
            and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == "MINIMAX_H3_TEXT_ENCODER_LAYER" for t in n.targets))
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[node], type_ignores=[]), "original-layer-constant", "exec"),
     sys.modules["unirl.models.minimax_h3.vendor"].__dict__)


def load(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, REPO / path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


load("unirl.config.require", "unirl/config/require.py")
load("unirl.utils.dtypes", "unirl/utils/dtypes.py")
store = load("unirl.models.minimax_h3.offline_text_embed", "unirl/models/minimax_h3/offline_text_embed.py")


def writer(path, **extra):
    options = dict(model_checkpoint="fixture-model-A", dtype="bfloat16", shard_size=2,
                   resume=False, force_overwrite=False)
    options.update(extra)
    return store.OfflineTextEmbedWriter(str(path), **options)


def rejects(call):
    try:
        call()
    except ValueError as error:
        return str(error)
    raise AssertionError("Expected ValueError")


result = {"torch": torch.__version__, "safetensors": safetensors.__version__}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="unirl-offline-store-") as temp:
    root = Path(temp)
    cache = root / "cache"
    tensors = {"prompt": torch.ones((1, 5120), dtype=torch.bfloat16),
               " prompt ": torch.full((2, 5120), 2, dtype=torch.bfloat16),
               "third": torch.full((3, 5120), 3, dtype=torch.bfloat16)}
    out = writer(cache)
    for prompt, tensor in tensors.items():
        out.add(prompt, tensor)
    out.close()
    assert len({store.compute_prompt_key(p) for p in tensors}) == 3
    reader = store.OfflineTextEmbedStore.from_dir(str(cache))
    for prompt, tensor in tensors.items():
        assert torch.equal(reader.get(prompt), tensor)
    reader.verify_coverage_or_raise(list(tensors), context="fixture")
    result["round_trip"] = {"prompts": 3, "shards": 2, "exact_whitespace_keys": True}
    for changed in (dict(model_checkpoint="fixture-model-B"), dict(dtype="float32")):
        rejects(lambda: writer(cache, resume=True, **changed))
    result["resume_metadata_rejections"] = 2
    index_path = cache / "index.json"
    original = index_path.read_bytes()
    index = json.loads(original)
    altered = {**index, "model_checkpoint": "fixture-model-B", "dtype": "float32"}
    index_path.write_text(json.dumps(altered))
    assert store.OfflineTextEmbedStore.from_dir(str(cache)).get("prompt").dtype == torch.bfloat16
    index_path.write_bytes(original)
    result["reader_metadata_is_not_runtime_identity_check"] = True
    broken = root / "missing-shards"
    broken.mkdir()
    (broken / "index.json").write_bytes(original)
    broken_reader = store.OfflineTextEmbedStore.from_dir(str(broken))
    broken_reader.verify_coverage_or_raise(list(tensors), context="fixture-missing-shards")
    rejects(lambda: broken_reader.get("prompt"))
    result["coverage_passes_before_missing_shard_get_fails"] = True
    resumed = writer(cache, resume=True, shard_size=1)
    with patch.object(store.os, "replace", side_effect=OSError("injected publication failure")):
        try:
            resumed.add("fourth", torch.ones((1, 5120), dtype=torch.bfloat16))
        except OSError as error:
            assert str(error) == "injected publication failure"
        else:
            raise AssertionError("Expected injected publication failure")
    assert index_path.read_bytes() == original
    assert (cache / "embeddings_00002.safetensors").exists()
    assert (cache / "index.json.tmp").exists()
    retry = writer(cache, resume=True, shard_size=1)
    assert store.compute_prompt_key("fourth") not in retry.entries and len(retry.entries) == 3
    retry.add("fourth", torch.full((1, 5120), 4, dtype=torch.bfloat16))
    retry.close()
    fresh = store.OfflineTextEmbedStore.from_dir(str(cache))
    for prompt, tensor in tensors.items():
        assert torch.equal(fresh.get(prompt), tensor)
    assert torch.equal(fresh.get("fourth"), torch.full((1, 5120), 4, dtype=torch.bfloat16))
    result["injected_replace_failure"] = "old index unchanged; orphan overwritten on fresh resume; 4 prompts readable"

    has_backward: bool
    micros: list

    guard = scope[method.name]
    cases = [

    ]
    print(rev, "source_sha256", hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest())
    for name, micros, backward, tolerance, expected, warning_count in cases:
        warnings.clear()
        result = Result(backward, micros, {"existing": 7})
        try:
            out = guard(NS(first_update_ratio_tol=tolerance), result)

            print(name, "KeyError:ratio_min")
            continue
        assert out.metrics["existing"] == 7
        assert result.metrics == {"existing": 7}
        if expected is None:
            assert out is result
        else:
            assert abs(out.metrics["first_update_ratio_dev"] - expected) < 1e-12
        assert len(warnings) == warning_count
        print(name, "PASS", out.metrics, "warnings", len(warnings))

"""Native spawned CPU pipe and original runtime helpers, not the vLLM engine lifecycle."""
import hashlib
import multiprocessing as mp
import os
import subprocess
import sys

HEAD = "6fd82cba13f52f394747832344039408699ea378"

def source(repo, path):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", repo, "show", f"{HEAD}:{path}"],
                                   env=dict(os.environ, GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH="1"))

def worker(conn, repo, previous, count):
    namespace = {"__name__": "original_runtime_helpers"}
    exec(compile(source(repo, "unirl/rollout/engine/vllm/runtime.py"), "runtime.py", "exec"), namespace)
    try:
        for _ in range(count):
            try:
                request = namespace["recv_request"](conn, last_request_id=previous)
            except namespace["ProtocolError"] as error:
                # Classification reply belongs to this harness, not runtime error policy.
                conn.send({"caught": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)})
                return
            previous = request["request_id"]
            namespace["send_response"](conn, request, ok=True, result={"echo": request})
    finally:
        conn.close()

def exchange(repo, messages, previous=0):
    ctx = mp.get_context("spawn")
    parent, child = ctx.Pipe(duplex=True)
    process = ctx.Process(target=worker, args=(child, repo, previous, len(messages)))
    process.start()
    child.close()
    responses = []
    try:
        for message in messages:
            parent.send(message)
            assert parent.poll(5), "helper child did not reply"
            responses.append(parent.recv())
        process.join(5)
        assert process.exitcode == 0, process.exitcode
    finally:
        parent.close()
        if process.is_alive():
            process.terminate()
            process.join(5)
    return responses
